request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: For positive integers A, B, C, x, y, z with A^x + B^y = C^z and x, y, z >= 3, then gcd(A, B, C) > 1. Strictly requires x,y,z >= 3 (strictly hyperbolic defect 1/x + 1/y + 1/z - 1 <= -1/12). Primitive solutions (gcd(A,B,C)=1) must be non-existent.
request_state.title: Frey-Hellegouarch Weierstrass Curves y^2 = x(x - A^x)(x + B^y)
request_state.formula: y^2 = x(x - A^x)(x + B^y), Delta = 16 (A^x B^y C^z)^2
request_state.description: Elliptic curves over Q whose minimal discriminant is a 2z-th or 2-power times conductor powers. Bounded levels 2, 32, 64, 144.

local_congruence_obstruction.instructions:

- unobstructed_locally: The family admits coprime solutions modulo all small primes.
